bagPolicy.summary: Each guest may bring one small bag no larger than A4 size (29.7 by 21 by 15 centimetres). Large bags and rucksacks are not permitted, and all bags may be searched.
allowed: One small bag no larger than A4 size (29.7 by 21 by 15 centimetres)
bagPolicy.note: Bring only essential items and allow time for security screening. Medical requirements should be discussed with the venue in advance.

parking.note: The venue is well served by public transport. A limited blue-badge bay is behind the venue on Pennard Road, and additional blue-badge parking is available at Westfield London on Ariel Way; confirm current restrictions before travelling.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in O2 Shepherds Bush Empire's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Bars operate inside the venue, with selection and opening points varying by event. Outside food and beverages are not permitted unless required for medical reasons and agreed with the venue.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you're coming to a show in the main auditorium or O2 Academy2 Birmingham, there's an accessible toilet on the balcony level (first floor), it’s controlled by a RADAR key and our staff will also provide access to it if needed and also in stalls.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in O2 Shepherds Bush Empire's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: You can book with Ticketmaster or come to the venue in person, our box office opening hours are on our Contact us page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at O2 Shepherds Bush Empire. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
